about: Lumbridge's farms. Fred's farm north-west of the castle: Fred the Farmer, his sheep pen's sheep, rams and lambs, and the chickens of the Wiki's Lumbridge West Farm (33, as on the Wiki's Chicken page), with the two sheep that never regrow their wool west of the castle. Tiles and types are RSMod's rev 233 Lumbridge spawns, which the Wiki's counts agree with; every wander range is guessed (5) until recorded. Groats' farm north of Lumbridge: Gillie Groats in the dairy cows' pen (the cows are locs; the farm's beef cows are in lumbridge.json). Mill Lane Mill: Millie Miller on its ground floor. The ducks are in lumbridge-ducks.json. Left out until their steps: the farmers, and The Thing and the penguin of Cold War.
